anomalies.description: A person in mid-air (likely airborne due to being thrown or jumping) collides with or is struck by another individual near a market stall; the dynamic pose suggests physical combat initiation.
Two individuals are engaged in close physical struggle inside a doorway; one appears to be pushing or grappling the other, consistent with mutual combat.
A person is seen climbing over a wall while being physically restrained or pulled back by another individual behind them, indicating active resistance and physical conflict.

A man in a black shirt and cap raises a handgun with his right hand and appears to fire it; muzzle flash or recoil is not visible, but the posture and weapon orientation strongly indicate an active shooting motion.
A man with a backpack physically engages another man on stone steps: he grabs or shoves him (f11), then appears to lift or throw him (f12–f13), indicating mutual or one-sided physical combat.
A hand holds a black semi-automatic pistol pointed forward against a concrete wall; the gun is clearly visible and aimed, consistent with an imminent or ongoing shooting action.
The man with the backpack appears to be engaged in a physical struggle or being grabbed from behind by another person near the railing; motion blur and body positioning suggest close-contact combat.
